title: No trust from Sara Duterte? Supreme Court says courts decide ‘based on law and evidence’
summary: The Supreme Court said Wednesday that cases “are decided based on law and evidence”, in response to Vice President Sara Duterte’s remarks expressing a lack of trust in the justice system.
